_doc: Controls how much autonomy the EA has for different task types. Four tiers: button-required (click Send/Create button in Slack, code-enforced), ask-first (post to Slack, wait for approval), do-and-tell (do it, then notify on Slack), fire-and-forget (do it silently, include in next briefing). User can promote tasks in Slack by saying e.g. 'for LoR uploads, just do it and tell me.'

send_email.note: Sends email as the user. Requires clicking Send button in Slack. Code-enforced via confirmation token.

send_calendar_invite.note: Creates calendar event with attendees (sends invite). Requires clicking Create button in Slack. Code-enforced.

schedule_deferred_send.note: Schedules an email to send at a future date. Requires button approval. Code-enforced.

delete_email.note: Permanently deletes an email (not archive). Requires button approval. Code-enforced.

delete_calendar_event.note: Deletes a calendar event. Requires button approval. Code-enforced.

draft_email_response.note: Show draft in Slack, wait for 'send' or edits. Creating/editing drafts is safe -- no external effect.

send_scheduling_availability.note: Can be promoted to do-and-tell for specific contacts.

upload_letter_of_recommendation.note: Match incoming LoR request against known letters. Upload and notify on Slack with the letter shown. User can undo.

prep_reimbursement_email.note: Compile receipts, draft the email to the department's reimbursement address, show in chat for approval.

create_calendar_hold.note: Block focus time or travel time (no attendees). Button-gated like all event creation -- write pending-event.json with attendees='' and let the bot post a Create-button confirmation. Code-enforced.

archive_email.note: Move processed items to archive. Notify on Slack. Reversible -- does not delete.

post_slack_summary.note: Briefings and status updates. Always autonomous.

fill_scheduling_poll.note: Fill When2Meet/WhenIsGood/Doodle polls. Shows conflict summary and asks about standing meeting overbookings before filling. URL-locked to known poll domains.

build_deck.note: Draft a Slidev deck in the EA's own workspace, stage it on the tailnet (reachable by the user's tailscale devices only) and post the URL and PDF. No external effect: the route is made by the owner's mediator, which has no Funnel verb, so the deck cannot be made public by the EA.

per_contact_overrides._doc: When user says 'for Dr. Smith, just send scheduling' in Slack, add an entry here. The EA checks this before defaulting to the task tier.

inbox_as_completion._doc: When enabled, archiving an email from the inbox (via Outlook, mobile, etc.) automatically closes the corresponding ledger item. The inbox is treated as an alternate completion signal: if you moved it out, you handled it. Disable if you prefer to close ledger items only through the EA. This is an Inbox Zero pattern -- if you don't practice Inbox Zero, set enabled to false.
inbox_as_completion.note: Checked every 15 min by ledger_sync.py. Silent -- no Slack notification (user already knows, they archived it themselves).

never_autonomous: Sending a first email to anyone outside the institution (institution.domains in user-profile.json)
Anything involving money, contracts, or legal commitments
Responding to program officers or deans
Exposing anything to the public internet (Tailscale Funnel). Decks are tailnet-only; sharing outside the tailnet means sending the PDF.

promote_after_n_successes.note: After the EA successfully handles N instances of a task type at ask-first without the user making changes, suggest promoting to do-and-tell.
